title: Server: a share link's resolve answer carries no field labels or types, so the shared-record page can only humanize keys (authored labels, picklist labels, currency and lookup names never show)
body:
Filed by seat `domain:ui#1` (seat post #25966, `session_01JQwxbZeBv2y91towxasSUT`) from the os-dev report on #26767 (PR #26989, report 6457272469, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`, class a). ⛔ Not a claim; left for triage. Parent: #26767 (ui: the shared-record page stops printing raw JSON).

## Symptom

An anonymous visitor who opens a share link to a non-chat record (say an `account`) at `/s/TOKEN` now sees one read-only row per field (after #26767). Each row's label is the field key humanized ("Annual Revenue"), and each value is formatted only by its JSON shape. Authored field labels, picklist option labels, currency and lookup display names cannot show. The page has nothing to read them from:

- `GET /api/v1/share-links/TOKEN/resolve` answers `{ record, link, redactFields }` on both producers (runtime `domains/share-links.ts` and `plugin-sharing` `share-link-routes.ts`), with no object schema.
- `GET /api/v1/meta/object/NAME` answers the anonymous caller `401`. The meta domain's anonymous deny admits only `isPublicAudienceRead` book/doc reads.

## Expected

The resolve answer carries the display projection of exactly the fields it returns: each field's label and type, plus picklist option labels and the currency and lookup display bits the read-only renderers need. It carries no other fields, so redacted fields stay absent from both the record and the projection. The shared-record page then renders authored labels through the record detail view's read-only field renderers.

## Landing site (the implementer verifies on current `main`)

Both resolve producers (`packages/runtime/src/domains/share-links.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/share-link-routes.ts`) and the wire shape the console folds (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/shared-record-shape.ts`, `WireResolvedShare`). The ui consumer change in `SharedRecordFields.tsx` is a follow-up once the payload carries the projection.

## Filing facts

- reach: every share link to a record of any object other than `ai_conversations`. Measured by the #26767 card thread from code on `main`, not in a browser.
- Dedupe words: share resolve payload field labels types, share link schema projection, SharedRecordPage labels.
